# THE BEAUTINALS — XXXI CANONICAL INSCRIPTIONS

> A curated Genesis collection of 31 cryptographic masterworks permanently inscribed on Bitcoin Ordinals (Sub-1.2M, Spring 2023). Curated by Lux Aeterna.

## Collection Architecture
The 31 masterworks are strictly structured across eight conceptual cycles:

## Fiduciary & Release Governance
- The Irrevocable Edict (2027–2057): A maximum of 1 masterpiece released per calendar year via authorized live auction.
- Primary stewardship, provenance, and consignment authorisation are governed under strict institutional and fiduciary custody.
